text:
Alex: T-45 to quiet window. quick preflight thread. whos got last-mile? :clock1:
Rina: SRE here. smoke scripts warmed, canary infra green, drain hooks staged.
Tom: Release notes are at https://internal/release/2026-03-22-notes. check the customer comms section.
Ivy: Product okayed the UX tweak. no experiments and no flags during window.
DeployBot: Rollout queued: rollout-9021 -> backend:v3.5.0. Canary target eu-north-1, 2 pods.
Rina: Canary health targets: p95 < 250ms, errors < 0.4%. Baseline snapshot taken.
Alex: Owners: canary watch Rina/Tom, traffic ops Alex/Rina, rollback lead Tom. Pager routed to @Pager.
Pager: Escalation chain validated: Pager -> oncall -> eng-lead. thresholds pushed.
Tom: Rollback criteria (agree):
- sustained error rate > 0.8% for 4m OR
- p95 latency +40% over baseline for 5m OR
- confirmed regression in critical flow reported by Product.
Alex: Quick rollback commands for copy:
```
# rollback to last stable
kubectl rollout undo deployment/backend --namespace=prod --to-revision=5
# deploybot revert
deploybot revert rollout-9021 --to v3.4.9
```
Rina: Canary ramp plan: 0% -> 4% (8m) -> 20% (18m) -> 60% (25m) -> 100% (9m). 10m holds between ramps.
Ivy: Product will do UX sanity at 20% hold (first 10m).
Alex: Freeze rules: no infra changes, no config flips, docs locked except comms. emergency patch must include rollback plan.
DeployBot: Preflight checks: config-lint=pass, infra-health=pass, smoke=pass.
Rina: Running smoke-run now:
```
smoke-run --suite quick
OK datastore
OK caches
WARN ephemeral-worker warmup 2/3 at t=50s
```
Alex: If warmup not 3/3 within 5m, we abort. Rina to call abort or GO.
Rina: Roger. I'll post abort if needed.
Tom: Remember pin policy: we pin previous stable for 30m post-rollout. unpin only after ops signoff.
Ivy: Customer banner drafted, communications on standby.
Pager: Alerts set: error-rate-3m, latency-p95-10m, auth-errors. runbooks linked in pager.
Alex: knobs: quantization=off for rollout, batch-size conservative, cache-ttl=45s first 30m.
Rina: Starting canary in T-30. say GO to kick.
Ivy: GO in 5.
DeployBot: Canary start -> 4% traffic. rollout-9021 warming pods.
Alex: Monitoring dashboards now. tagging @Ivy @Tom for visibility.
